name: Percent Troll
description: Freezes the game and plays a video or sound inside Geometry Dash when you die at a specific percentage. Put <cy>.mpg</c> videos (MPEG-1) or mp3/ogg/wav files in the mod's media folder. Use the <cy>Troll Folder</c> button in the pause menu to open it.

target-percent.name: Troll Percent
target-percent.description: Dying anywhere in this percent (e.g. 67 = 67.0% to 67.9999%) triggers the troll.

media-file.name: Media File Name
media-file.description: Optional. File name inside the media folder (e.g. troll.mpg). Leave empty to pick a random file from the folder. A video plays its sound from a file with the same name (troll.mp3).

message.name: Top Text
message.description: Text shown at the top of the screen. {percent} is replaced with the percent you died at.

freeze-game.name: Freeze Game
freeze-game.description: Stops the game while the troll plays, so you don't respawn and keep dying at 0%.

duration-seconds.name: Freeze Duration (seconds)
duration-seconds.description: Only used for sound files and text. Videos freeze the game for exactly their own length.
